messages:
Alex: Quick sync — RFC review meeting Wed Mar 10 10:30am PT. Need to slot authors and confirm reviewers. Who's available to review?
Mira: I can present my RFC (streaming-kv-cache). Prefer an early slot if possible.
Devon: I can review Mira and Sam. Can we get pre-reads by EOD Tue so reviewers have time?
Alex: Yep — please post links asap. Draft agenda below (will adjust based on slots):
```
Agenda (40m total)
1) Quick updates & housekeeping (5m)
2) RFC: streaming-kv-cache — author: Mira (15m)
   reviewers: Jen, Devon
3) RFC: async-retry-policy — author: Sam (10m)
   reviewers: Alex, Luis
4) Open triage / action items (10m)
Pre-reads: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/streaming-kv-cache, https://redwood.internal/rfcs/async-retry-policy
Notes: please put 1-2 bullet comments in the doc, not just inline questions during the meeting.
```
SchedulerBot: Calendar event created: "Redwood RFC Review" Wed Mar 10 10:30am PT — invite sent to #eng.
Sophie: Heads up — I have infra RFC that I want a quick slot for. Could we slide a 5–10m micro-update after the two RFCs?
Jen: Suggest we order by complexity. If Mira's is heavy, Mira goes first. Otherwise put the infra blip last.
Sam: I can present at either slot but prefer later. I have a client call at 10:20 PT but can be back by 10:40 if needed.
Luis: Oncall rotation conflicts for me 10:25–10:50 PT. I can still review asynchronously but might miss the live Q&A for that window.
Alex: Proposal: Mira 10:30–10:45, Sam 10:45–10:55, Sophie (infra) 10:55–11:05, then triage. Reviewers: Jen/Devon for Mira; Alex/Luis for Sam (Luis will join if freed, otherwise async). Sound good?
Mira: Works for me — I've just pushed the pre-read: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/streaming-kv-cache (added TL;DR at top). Pls comment on perf section.
Sam: Pre-read up: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/async-retry-policy — added example flows and perf tradeoffs. I'm OK with the 10:45 slot.
Jen: ✅ I'll review both docs tonight and add summary comments by Tue EOD.
Devon: I'll skim and add a few questions inline. If anything needs deeper discussion, flag it in the doc so we can prioritize during the meeting.
Luis: I'll try to step out of rotation but if not, I can leave notes for Alex to read aloud.
Alex: Great — final plan: Mira first, Sam second, Sophie micro-update third. Reviewers assigned as above. I'll update the invite with the agenda snippet and set reminder for pre-reads Tue 6pm PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Mira: Thanks!
Sam: Thanks — see you Wed.
Jen: See you.
SchedulerBot: Reminder scheduled: Pre-read reminder Tue Mar 9 6:00pm PT to @eng.
